translation: Took place in posad Serock, [unclear: 3rd/23rd] September 1890, 7 AM. Appeared personally Majer Mendzylewski, shopkeeper, 25, and Berek [unclear: Kochin/Kolpin], laborer, 65, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 6 AM died Rafal Zylbersztejn, 4 years of age, born in posad Serock, son of Moszek and Basia, the Zylbersztejn spouses, traders. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Rafal Zylbersztejn this act was read, signed by us and one witness; the second witness is illiterate.
